verdict.rationale: Trello documents an official MCP server that lets 'any AI tool' connect to it (trello-docs-6), so users can operate Trello through natural-language commands, but only via an external AI client. The 'Use AI to help write or edit content' feature (trello-docs-32) covers content drafting, not commanding the product. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, hands-on or independent corroboration of NL operation working.
